Initial read looks good; they had one quick question about retention windows in the "Data retention & deletion" section: can you confirm the default retention period for inference logs and whether customers can configure shorter retention?

Hi Alyssa —

Quick answer on retention: by default Redwood retains inference logs for 30 days; customers can configure retention down to 7 days on Private deployments and via the Dashboard for Dedicated. For hosted API customers we also offer an option to purge logs on request, and we can scope retention by token type if needed.

I've attached a one-page summary of retention controls (excerpt from the packet) to make it easier to share with Security.

If your team prefers a walkthrough, Monica and I are available next week on Tuesday 8/25 between 10–12 PT or Wednesday 8/26 2–4 PT — or you can pick any 15-min slot here: https://calendly.com/markus-redwood/15

Let me know what works and we'll lock it in.

Thanks,
--
Markus
